title: Model routing pinwalk timetable and rollback heuristics (Apr 2027) - draft
content:
Purpose and scope:
This is a working runbook for a targeted, locality-aware model pin and progressive traffic pulse ("pinwalk") for model-routing changes that affect quantized variants and latency. It bundles a short timetable, preflight checklist, observability thresholds, and a compact rollback/mitigation matrix.

TL;DR (one-paragraph):
When we need to pin a region to a specific model variant (e.g., q4_1x8 vs q3_k_mixed) due to either cost or subtle quality regressions, run a pinwalk: a ~24–36h staged schedule with short pulses of traffic in each region, tight telemetry checks, and explicit rollback triggers based on latency, error-rate, or coherence regressions against our eval prompts. This doc defines the owners, smoke tests, metric thresholds and immediate actions.

When to use this flow:
- Model variant swap in production that changes quantization/profile or kernel selection.
- Routing policy update that will change per-region model variant selection.
- Expected small user-visible quality regression risk but high cost benefit.

Not applicable for:
- Full model upgrades (major architecture changes) — use full release playbook.
- Emergency hotfixes — use fast rollback runway.

Quick glossary:
- pin: force a region/route to a single model variant.
- pulse: target a % of traffic for a short window (5–30 mins).
- pinwalk: sequence of pin + pulse actions across regions.

Schedule (proposed, target = low-traffic day, 48h runway):
- Day 0, 09:00 PT: Preflight window open — all owners online, preflight checks.
- Day 0, 10:00 PT: Canary pulse US-WEST (5% traffic, 20m). Owner: @liam (serving-runtime).
- Day 0, 13:00 UTC: Canary pulse EU-WEST (5% traffic, 20m). Owner: @priya (observability).
- Day 0, 22:00 IST: Canary pulse AP-SOUTH (3% traffic, 30m). Owner: @marco (platform).
- Day 1, 09:00 PT: Expand US-WEST to 25% (3 x 20m pulses separated by 40m).
- Day 1, 13:00 UTC: If stable, expand EU-WEST to 25%.
- Day 1, 20:00 IST: AP-SOUTH expansion to 20% (if stable).
- Day 2, 09:00 PT: Full regional pin (100%) for non-critical routes OR continue measured ramp for high-sensitivity routes.

Preflight checklist (must be green before first pulse):
- Owners confirmed in #release-pinwalk Slack (Dana, Liam, Priya, Marco).
- Latest serving-runtime image deployed to staging with model-variant tag PR#5563 tested.
- Smoke suite: latency, 95p tail, token-per-request distribution run against staging with pinned model; median latency delta <= +10ms compared to baseline.
- Eval harness: run benchmark prompts (pinned_eval_suite) and compare top-1/quality metrics; no regression >2% on critical prompts.
- Capacity check: autoscaler headroom >= 2x estimated QPS during pulses (sheet: capacity-projection-ENG-4127).
- Telemetry hooks validated: token-level cost, latencies (p50/p95/p99), error rates, model-id in logs, KV-cache hit ratio.
- Alerting ready: temp alert thresholds created for pinwalk windows (see alert snippets below).

Immediate smoke tests during each pulse:
- Synthetic requests: ramp to pulse % using load generator (k6 scenario), check latency p95 and error rate in real-time.
- Shadow eval: run 100 eval prompts against newly pinned model; compare to baseline tracking dashboard.
- User-sampling: sample 50 real requests (redact tokens) and run quick quality sniff for hallucination/regression.

Success criteria for expansion (must be true for 60m post-pulse):
- p95 latency delta vs baseline <= +25ms AND p99 delta <= +50ms.
- 5xx error rate <= baseline + 0.05% absolute AND overall error rate not increasing trend for 30m.
- No >3/100 quality failures on pinned_eval_suite critical prompts.
- KV-cache hit ratio stable (no >10% drop).
- Cost: per-token spending within expected delta for quantized variant (sheet: expected-economics-ENG-4127).

Rollback / mitigation matrix (fast actions):
Triggers and first responder actions (within 0–5 mins):
- Trigger A — p99 latency spike > +100ms sustained for 5m: immediately drop pulse to 0% and revert region to previous routing (unpin). Notify SRE and product.
- Trigger B — 5xx rate increases > 0.2% absolute for 10m: throttle pulses (to 1%) and open debug trace; escalate to on-call.
- Trigger C — eval-suite quality regression > 5% on critical prompts: stop rollout, rollback pin, create regression ticket ENG-xxxx.
- Trigger D — KV-cache collapse (drop >20%): temporarily pin to fallback model variant with larger KV footprint; open perf debug.

Rollback steps (explicit):
1) Owner issues rollback via routing API (route-pin revert command) and posts to #release-pinwalk with time and reason.
2) Re-deploy last-known-good routing config if required (PR revert in serving-runtime).
3) Keep telemetry for 60m post-rollback and run a targeted smoke to confirm stability.
4) Draft immediate incident note with timestamped actions and retain sampled request traces.

Communication plan (who says what):
- On every pulse start/end: owner posts to #release-pinwalk with tag @release-watch and short summary.
- If rollback: owner files an incident note in the release-pad (link in #release-pinwalk) and pings product leads.
- Customer-facing: if rollback causes visible degradation for enterprise tenants, CS lead drafts a short status update.

Observability (dashboards & alerts):
- Dashboards: pinwalk-summary (region/model/route), latency-tail, error-by-route, eval-quality-over-time, kv-cache-health.
- Temp alerts to create before start: PINWALK_LAT_P99_HIGH, PINWALK_ERROR_RATE, PINWALK_EVAL_REGRESSION, PINWALK_KV_DROP.
- Tracing: enable sampling=100% for pinned routes during pulses.

Data collection for postmortem:
- 30m raw traces covering first noticeable deviation.
- Sampled requests + model responses (redacted).
- Eval harness run artifacts and diff reports.
- Autoscaler logs and GPU utilization heatmaps.

Draft release notes (internal / user-impact summary):
- Internal: "Applied a locality pin to select regions to serve with q4_1x8 quantized variant to reduce per-token cost by ~18% while maintaining SLOs. Progressive pinwalk executed with staged pulses in US-WEST, EU-WEST, AP-SOUTH. No customer-facing incidents observed during expansion. See ENG-4127 for rollback heuristics and PR#5563 for runtime changes."
- Customer-facing short (if needed): "We rolled out a targeted backend optimization that reduces inference cost while preserving response latency and quality for most workloads. No action required on your side; please contact support if you see degraded responses."

Open questions / TODOs (short):
- Should pulses be run at different local times to catch diurnal patterns? (Priya: propose alternative 48h schedule)
- Add regression gating for embedded similarity drift (backlog).
- Confirm whether enterprise tenant routing should be excluded by default or opt-in. (Marco to confirm legal/contract)
- Create small automaton to auto-decrease pulse if p95 crosses threshold for 2m (automation spike).

References & artifacts to attach before execution:
- Confluence: Pinwalk Design Spec (linked above).
- Jira: ENG-4127 (scheduling + rollback), ENG-4138 (telemetry gaps).
- GitHub: PR#5563 (serving-runtime changes), PR#5589 (console exposure).

Notes to reviewers:
- This is intentionally conservative on thresholds; teams can propose looser economics if product agrees.
- Prefer to run during a weekday local morning to have SRE overlap.

Contact on-call list (primary/secondary):
- Primary: Liam Chen (@liam)
- Secondary: Priya Rao (@priya)
- Product contact: Dana Murray (@dana)
